# T-4: Implement draft repair

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Implement triage and repair execution for draft review findings, including repair audit writing and draft.json mutation only during repair leaves.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Triage writes one item per blocking finding or repair target.
- Triage accepts only apply, invalid, already_resolved, downgraded_to_non_blocking, and requires_user_decision.
- Repair writes one item per apply decision and records changed draft.json fields.
- Triage and review do not mutate draft.json; repair is the only mutation step.
- Coverage repair sets draft approval when no requires_user_decision item remains.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse the existing prompt-builder and JSON parsing patterns. Keep question-stage and coverage-stage metadata distinct through phase/sourceReview/sourceTriage fields.

## Test Strategy
Tests cover no-op triage/repair, applied repair, and requires-user-decision repair behavior.
